# Disable expression by law and public content

## National level, highest level, best type of term

|  |
| --- |
| In principle, the following expressions are not used to market goods or services: |
| Express terms of the law: national, highest, best. |
| Absolute advocacy equivalent to or highly comparable to national products, national brands, world-class, world-highest, global top, top, top, top, most advanced, front, most advanced, most advanced, most professional, most secure, most reliable, most accurate, fastest, cheapest, most worthwhile, most extreme, top, most peak, ultimate, absolute ahead, unmatched. |
| The country's first, global first, industry first, No.1, TOP 1, brand 1, market share first, sales first, unique, exclusive, first, first, first, first, first, leading, industry poles, and far ahead. |
| Unproven authoritative expression: State certification, State designation, government designation, official accreditation, certification of authority, exclusiveness of State organs, specialty, specialty. |
| In the case of official awards, qualifications, rank, fixed title or a limited range of verifiable facts, the words “highest” “first” “national” may reasonably appear. Such expressions should accurately refer to full, objective facts and scope of application and should not be extended to propaganda conclusions. |

## Absolute impact, security and zero risk commitment

|  |
| --- |
| Absolute effects: 100 per cent effective, 100 per cent accurate, complete, definitive, one-off, immediate, permanent, no error, zero error, zero failure, no loss. |
| Absolute safety: 100% safety, absolute safety, zero risk, zero risk, never-ending, never-discovery, no risk, full confidentiality. |
| It is absolutely applicable: it applies to the owner, to any enterprise, to the whole scene, without any conditions, to the zero threshold, to the zero cost of learning, to the complete exemption from maintenance. |
| Absolute commitment: guarantees of success, success of the package, inclusion, satisfaction, unconditional refunds (if inconsistent with the actual provisions), certainty, necessity, absolute, never. |
| It was suggested to replace the word “support” with “support” to “help” to supplement product versions, testing environments, service ranges or contractual terms, subject to agreed configuration and applicable conditions. |

## False credentials, endorsements and false images

|  |
| --- |
| Not obtained or expired but declared: State certification, authoritative certification, official partners, designated suppliers, recommendations from industry associations, accreditation by an institution. |
| :: The fraudulent or disguised use of the names or images of State organs, agents of State organs and violations of the flag, emblem, flag, emblem, etc. |
| The name, portrait, voice, evaluation, case, trademark, Logo or customer list is used without written consent for endorsement. |
| Fiction or exaggeration of patents, soft writing, awards, sales, number of clients, R & D inputs, team size, coverage areas, go-live and partnerships. |

## Demeaning competition and commercial defamation

|  |
| --- |
| Negative and unsubstantiated characterization of the competition: liars, garbage, bunkers, hypocrisy, backwardness, phase-out, insecurity, non-compliance, worthless, unreliable. |
| There is no evidence of a derogatory comparison: total crushing, hanging, far more than all peers, the competition is impossible and traditional products are useless. |
| To fabricate, disseminate or direct others to disseminate false or misleading information to the detriment of the commercial or commercial reputation of others. |
| Functions and parameters should be comparable, but verifiable information of the same calibre, period and condition should be used and derogatory conclusions avoided. |

## Illegal and undesirable public content

|  |
| --- |
| It is prohibited to produce, reproduce, publish as propaganda claims or effects: |
| (c) The content that endangers the security of the State, discloses State secrets, undermines the unity of the State or impairs the dignity, honour and interests of the State. |
| Discrimination and hate speech based on ethnicity, race, religion, gender, geography, disease or disability. |
| Obscenity, pornography, gambling, superstition, terror, violence, incitement to crime, cyberviolence, human search, etc. |
| The disclosure of personal privacy, infringement of the legitimate rights and interests of others, endangering the safety of persons or property, and elements contrary to public order. |
| Rumours, falsifications, the use of exaggerating titles and serious discrepancies in content, flows, false accounts and false interactions. |
